info.title: Lightsmith API
info.description: Lightsmith job API. Local mode: single user, no auth. Hosted mode: `Authorization: Bearer <api key | platform JWT>`. Errors are `{error, message}` JSON. See API.md.

get.description:
JSON Schema of every problem kind: the envelope `{"problem": <union on kind>}`.
`?kind=scattering` returns the scattering Simulation schema alone.

post.description: For each backend of the problem's kind: whether it is installed and whether it can run this problem.
Create an API key for the caller's org. The key is shown once.

schema.title: Response Create Key V1 Keys Post
Response List Keys V1 Keys Get
Response Revoke Key V1 Keys  Key Id  Delete

get.description: Billing state of the caller's org: plan, subscription, usage against limits, and what it can do.

schema.title: Response Checkout V1 Billing Checkout Post
Response Portal V1 Billing Portal Post

post.description:
Switch the org's subscription between paid plans (prorated by Stripe). The plan changes when
Stripe confirms through the webhook; poll GET /v1/billing.

schema.title: Response Change Plan V1 Billing Plan Post

put.description: Set the org's own monthly credit limit (a spending cap below the plan's hard limit).

schema.title: Response Set Credit Limit V1 Billing Limits Put

post.description: Stripe webhook (signature-verified, test mode only). Configure it in the Stripe dashboard.

schema.title: Response Stripe Webhook V1 Billing Webhook Post

get.description: Usage per org over a period (default: this calendar month, UTC).

schema.title: Response Admin Usage V1 Admin Usage Get
Response Admin Usage Daily V1 Admin Usage Daily Get
Response Admin Orgs V1 Admin Orgs Get

get.description:
One org's billing state, its latest usage records (with their Stripe meter status) and the
Stripe events applied to it.

schema.title: Response Admin Org V1 Admin Orgs  Org Id  Get
Response Admin Set Plan V1 Admin Orgs  Org Id  Plan Put

put.description: Replace the plan's monthly hard limit for one org (null restores the plan's).

schema.title: Response Admin Set Limits V1 Admin Orgs  Org Id  Limits Put

post.description: Retry usage records whose Stripe meter event failed.

schema.title: Response Admin Billing Sync V1 Admin Billing Sync Post

credit_cap_override.title: Credit Cap Override
credit_cap_override.description: Replaces the plan's monthly hard limit for this org (null: back to the plan's).

monthly_credit_limit.title: Monthly Credit Limit
monthly_credit_limit.description: Most credits the org may use per month (null: the plan's hard limit).

error.title: Error
error.description: Error type, e.g. ValidationError, Timeout, MemoryLimitExceeded, Cancelled.

simulation.title: Simulation
simulation.description: Any lightsmith problem as JSON (see GET /v1/schema). Without `kind` it is a scattering Simulation; other kinds: layer_stack, periodic, mode, device, bands, circuit, optimization. Alias: `spec`.

quota_warning.title: Quota Warning
quota_warning.description: Hosted: set when this job takes the org past the soft limit of its monthly credits or into billed overage.

next_before.title: Next Before
next_before.description: Pass as ?before= for the next page.

simulation.title: Simulation
simulation.description: Any lightsmith problem as JSON (see GET /v1/schema). Without `kind` it is a scattering Simulation; other kinds: layer_stack, periodic, mode, device, bands, circuit, optimization. Alias: `spec`.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: solve | compare | estimate (run as a job) | optimize (an optimization problem). Alias: `operation`.

method.title: Method
method.description: solve: method or backend name, or 'auto'.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: compare: reference method (default: Mie if run).

label.title: Label
label.description: Free text shown in job lists.

problem_kind.title: Problem Kind
problem_kind.description: scattering | layer_stack | periodic | mode | device | bands | circuit | optimization.

message.title: Message
message.description: Short human-readable state, or the error message.

result.title: Result
result.description: Result JSON (solve) or compare JSON; null until succeeded, or when larger than the inline limit (then use result_url).

result_kind.title: Result Kind
result_kind.description: The result model's `kind` (cross_sections, spectrum, modes, sparameters, bands, optimization, ...), or compare / estimate.

simulation.title: Simulation
simulation.description: Any lightsmith problem as JSON (see GET /v1/schema). Without `kind` it is a scattering Simulation; other kinds: layer_stack, periodic, mode, device, bands, circuit, optimization. Alias: `spec`.
